bullets: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: add Section 5c that FAILs on a copied UWP windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint extension lacking a windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer registration — this is the deterministic cause of the 0x80080204 AppX-registration failure that leaves a clean-building app unlaunchable.

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: add manifest-checklist item 5 to reconcile UWP <Extension> blocks (esp. windows.backgroundTasks) — remove by default for foreground parity, or add an inProcessServer ActivatableClass for full fidelity.

SKILL.md: extend the Package.appxmanifest healthcheck bullet to flag orphaned windows.backgroundTasks extensions and link the checklist, so the manifest step is understood as full reconciliation, not just three attribute fixes.
